section_title: Article 113 - For specific performance of a contract
content: First Schedule, Article 113 of The Limitation Act, 1908: Suit for specific performance of a contract. Period of limitation: Three (3) years. Time from which period begins to run: The date fixed for the performance, or, if no such date is fixed, when the plaintiff has notice that performance is refused.

section_title: Article 115 - For compensation for the breach of any contract
content: First Schedule, Article 115 of The Limitation Act, 1908: For compensation for the breach of any contract, express or implied, not in writing registered and not herein specially provided for. Period of limitation: Three (3) years. Time from which period begins to run: When the contract is broken, or (where there are successive breaches) when the breach in respect of which the suit is instituted occurs.

section_title: Power to direct admission to bail or reduction of bail
content: Section 498 of The Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898: Power to direct admission to bail or reduction of bail. The High Court Division or Court of Session may, in any case, whether there be an appeal on conviction or not, direct that any person be admitted to bail, or that the bail required by a police-officer or Magistrate be reduced.

act_name: The Hindu Women's Rights to Property Act, 1937
section_title: Devolution of property on Hindu widow
content: Section 3 of The Hindu Women's Rights to Property Act, 1937: Devolution of property. When a Hindu governed by the Dayabhaga School of Hindu Law dies intestate leaving any property, his widow, or if there is more than one widow all his widows together, shall be entitled in respect of property in respect of which he dies intestate to the same share as a son. Any interest devolving on a Hindu widow under the provisions of this section shall be the limited interest known as a Hindu woman's estate, provided however that she shall have the same right of claiming partition as a male owner.

section_title: Extent of original jurisdiction of District or Joint District Judge
content: Section 18 of The Civil Courts Act, 1887: Save as otherwise provided by any enactment for the time being in force, the original jurisdiction of a District Judge or Joint District Judge extends, subject to the provisions of section 15 of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, to all original suits for the time being cognizable by Civil Courts without any pecuniary limit. Property disputes or civil suits valued at high amounts (e.g. Tk 4.5 Crore or above) lie within the original civil jurisdiction of the Joint District Judge.

section_title: সারচার্জ ও সম্পদ করের হার (Surcharge and Wealth Tax Rates)
content: আয়কর আইন, ২০২৩ এর অধীনে নিট সম্পদের ভিত্তিতে সারচার্জ (Surcharge / Wealth Tax): নিট সম্পদের পরিমাণ ৪ কোটি টাকা পর্যন্ত হলে সারচার্জ শূন্য; ৪ কোটি টাকার অধিক কিন্তু ১০ কোটি টাকার মধ্যে হলে ১০%; ১০ কোটি টাকার অধিক কিন্তু ২০ কোটি টাকার মধ্যে হলে ২০%; ২০ কোটি টাকার অধিক কিন্তু ৫০ কোটি টাকার মধ্যে হলে ৩০%; এবং ৫০ কোটি টাকার অধিক হলে ৩৫% হারে সারচার্জ বা সম্পদ কর প্রযোজ্য হয়।
